services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Who were the dinosaurs? When did they live? And how do we know? Learn the answers to all of these questions, guided by our staff members. Students will make their own fossil to take home. Learn about gravity, our solar system, and space exploration in our Space Room! Students will get to make their own model planets. Join us in the APCM Art Studio for an immersive artistic experience. Learn about diverse artists and their techniques. Experiment with new materials. Students will complete their own mixed-media piece to present and take home. Learn about coins, the value of money, and saving your cents.
